vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are opened immediately, pinned to the lowest fixing version, and routed by renovate-triage.yml (CVSS) between automerge and manual review.

customManagers.description: Keeps the versions quoted in README.md (results table) and docs/development.md in sync: each one carries a hidden marker mirroring the pin it documents (a variant's package.json, the setup-node version, OASDIFF_VERSION), so they move in the same PR.
Tool versions of the workflows, pinned in an env variable with a `# renovate:` comment above (OASDIFF_VERSION).

packageRules.description: Routine updates once a week. Not grouped: a tool bump changes what its variant measures, and each PR re-checks only the variants it touches.
nestoa itself is refreshed by refresh-nestoa.yml (bot/refresh-* PRs, with the new results): not by Renovate, which can't read @algoan/nestoa on GitHub Packages anyway.
nestjs-asyncapi and @nmime/nestjs-asyncapi deep-import @nestjs/swagger, which its later `exports` map breaks: they stay on 11.4.2 (docs/results.md).
algoan/renovate-security-actions runs the Renovate triage and automerge: its updates come in their own PR, for a human review.
TypeScript 7.0 ships no compiler API (back in 7.1): the Nest CLI, ts-jest and the generators need it
nestia 12+ needs TypeScript 7 (ttsc): keep the nestia variant on 11.x
